notes.title: Should we do a remake for this game ?
notes.content:
[p]When I made this game in 2017, it was both a fangame project (as a Dota 2 player) and my first attempt at game development.  
Never did I thought the game would garner even 50 players, let alone 1000 in one month of release itself, which was a surprise seeing people enjoy the game for what it was.[/p][p]But 8 years later, today, I see there are more than 100,000 players, unbelievable.[/p][p]And as such, I wanted to know if there is still some interest in the game, and if you folks would like to get a more modern remake of the game, a complete overhaul.  [/p][p]The gameplay and mechanics would stay the same, but a complete overhaul and redo of the characters and graphics in 2.5d/3d.[/p][p][/p][p]Let me know what you all think, and if there are any ideas or feedback you want to put forward.[/p]

notes.title: (Temporary) Patch for Auto-Unlocking Bugged Achievements
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30719317/dda0689467a822cd68fca485b5182a08a5d7abce.jpg[/img] [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30719317/df7fa2dce0ad5cb6c62dc22426888e6919b238bd.jpg[/img] [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30719317/8dcd06b641dca0a26ecaa0fa6a687a7aeb476767.jpg[/img]

Just to update everyone, we have pushed the above promised temporary patch update. Once you update the game and play it a few seconds/minute, it will automatically unlocked the much reported bugged Achievements (Monster Hunter, Coin Collector, King of Olympus and God of Olympus).  

This is a temporary patch available ONLY TILL THIS WEEKEND (Sunday, 18th Feb 2018) to automatically unlock the achievements for you.  
Starting next week, we are expecting to ship our new version of the Game (which will host various Dota 2 mini-fangames) and as such, the achievements will be completely revamped to match the new game system (conditions and icons).  

We will release a second game-mode update (another major change) after 2-3 weeks again. 

Currently, we are working on these 2 kinds of game modes:

1. Arcade Platformer 
You play as dota 2 heroes and have to dodge falling objects and keep climbing on them while surviving (think of tetris except that you need to climb on tetris blocks and keep surviving from hitting ground). 
Currently single player, with plans to add multiplayer mode to allow player interactions (jumping on/off each other or pushing each other away to make them hit falling objects and die) 

2. Shooting-Survival
Featuring Sniper and then expanding to a few more ranged heroes, you need to surive hordes of meele heroes by shooting/killing them (think of top-down zombie shooter, except ours in 3rd person or angular camera). Again, single player fist and with enough interest multiplayer. 

We will be able to provide some content updates and in-development progress in coming days to seek more feedback. 
If we get enough player interest, we will keep adding more fun game modes to turn this into a collection of different and many small but fun dota 2 fan games.

We advise everyone who wanted to get the bugged achievements unlocked to do so within this week/end itself.  

We will release a sneak peak of our first main game mode in next day(s).

notes.title: We are back
notes.content:
Run Zeus Run is back on Steam Store, is FreeToPlay and will be revamped into a totally better game in upcoming weeks.  
The game was taken down Steam Store due to Dota 2 copyright, but we were able to sort it out with Valve and even got permission to create and improve it as a Fan Game.  

As such, the game is now FreeToPlay and we will also be completely changing the game into something better, for which we are even open to feedback and suggestions.  
Currently, we are planning to change the game's core concept to that of a Survival Platformer where you need to dodge obstacles falling on a platform and survive. We also have plans to add coop and vs multiplayer to the same.  

The original concept of Endless Platform Runner will still be available as a mini-game within the new change.

notes.title: Improvements and Changes to Achievement requirements
notes.content:
Patch released with the following changes:  

1. Total coins achievement has been capped at 500 now (reaching 500 unlocks later achievements too earlier requiring 600, 800 and 1000 coins).  
2. Total monster kill requirements is now changed to 5,10,15,20,25 total.  
3. Community stats should now be updated and be finished, unlocking all community achievements.

notes.title: RunZeusRun Released and Achievements Guide
notes.content:
First of all, thank you for everyone who will buy the game and hope you enjoy it for what its worth.  
We are always open to feedback and criticism and if there is any improvement you would like to see to this, feel free to post in Community Hub/Discussions.  

For RunZeusRun game, we have a variety of scenarios which unlock various achievements but there is something unique we have used in the game called [b]"Community Achievements"[/b] which unlock for everyone, once a certain Community Goal has been achieved (some of such Community Achievements shown in below example).
